title: EZ-Ar-VC: Robust Arabic Voice Anonymization with Generalization across Dialects and Code-Switching
abstract: arXiv:2611.01268v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice conversion (VC) models can be used to anonymize speech data while preserving naturalness. Existing models, however, are mainly optimized for English and other high-resource languages, and they fail to generalize well to Arabic due to its distinct phonology. In this work, we comprehensively evaluate existing zero-shot VC systems for Arabic speech, identifying limitations in pronunciation preservation. We then train an Arabic-centric model based on EZ-VC on diverse Arabic speech, and demonstrate strong performance in intelligibility, naturalness, and pronunciation preservation, while maintaining high speaker dissimilarity. Through subjective evaluation, we further demonstrate its robustness to code-switching and cross-dialectal conversion, as well as its generalization to Arabic dialects with limited representation in the training data. Our findings highlight the limitations of zero-shot VC and the importance of target-language adapt

translated_title: EZ-Ar-VC：跨方言与语码转换泛化的鲁棒阿拉伯语语音匿名化
translated_abstract: 语音转换（VC）模型可用于在保持自然度的同时对语音数据进行匿名化处理。然而，现有模型主要针对英语及其他高资源语言进行优化，由于阿拉伯语独特的音系特征，这些模型难以很好地泛化到阿拉伯语上。在本研究中，我们全面评估了现有的零样本语音转换系统在阿拉伯语语音上的表现，识别出其在发音保持方面的局限性。随后，我们基于EZ-VC在多样化的阿拉伯语语音上训练了一个以阿拉伯语为中心的模型，该模型在可懂度、自然度和发音保持方面展现出强劲性能，同时保持了较高的说话人相异性。通过主观评估，我们进一步证明了该模型对语码转换和跨方言转换的鲁棒性，以及对训练数据中代表性不足的阿拉伯语方言的泛化能力。我们的研究结果凸显了零样本语音转换的局限性以及针对目标语言进行适配的重要性。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于EZ-VC的阿拉伯语专用语音转换模型EZ-Ar-VC，实现了阿拉伯语语音的匿名化，并在跨方言转换和语码转换场景下展现出优异的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EZ-Ar-VC, an Arabic-centric voice conversion model based on EZ-VC that achieves robust speech anonymization with strong generalization across Arabic dialects and code-switching scenarios.
